scope: Private CP5 distribution/content investigation only; no public implementation acceptance.

observations: Uniform is a pale, evenly stippled triangular field.
Vertex-biased concentrates dark grain at the first vertex (bottom left), tapering toward the opposite side.
The puntis3 coordinate pattern redistributes grain with a softer low-density edge region; its mean location alone understates the distribution difference.
Denser uniform has a visibly fuller triangular texture while retaining the earlier centres.
Coral recolouring changes appearance while keeping point placement; alpha also changes, so this is a combined style substitution.
Short horizontal strokes produce a much more legible textured triangular silhouette at the same centres; whole strokes may cross edges.

The CP4 transfer covers the canvas with coloured triangular grain regions, but yellow/teal regions are faint on the pale background. It proves composition transfer, not a finished recommended palette or density.

source_closure: All source/class/input and seven image hashes unchanged at acceptance.
decision: Retained triangle point batches and distribution substitution merit API design; do not equate active source grain with uniform sampling. Improve transfer styling in the eventual public example without rerendering this private attempt.
limitations: One completed native attempt; no rerender required or authorized by this plan.
JAVA2D private streams only; no Processing source-pixel or public sampler conformance.
No public default, continuous encouraged range or bias parameter admitted.
